constraints.rule: Every machine-actionable card must declare or infer exactly one primary card type.
CONCEPT_CARD must not define formal_modes as its primary structure; use operator_hooks instead.
OPERATOR_CARD must define arity or formal_modes unless explicitly unresolved.
YAML curated seeds may lack JSON mirrors only when status is seed or draft.
ROOT_OR_MISC files must appear in repo coherence report and not be silently ignored.
Generated artifacts must not override canonical YAML/JSON source data.
DEICTIC_CARD may be unresolved, but must declare anchor domain.
SCOPE_CARD must preserve unresolved scope instead of collapsing to guessed meaning.
